title: deparia pycnosora var. longidens
intro: Deparia pycnosora var. longidens, commonly known as the Korean polypody, is a type of fern that belongs to the family Athyriaceae. It has been traditionally used in East Asian medicine for its potential health benefits, including reducing inflammation and improving cardiovascular health. The therapeutic actions of Deparia pycnosora var. longidens are attributed to its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and anticoagulant properties, which may help to prevent the formation of blood clots and lower blood pressure. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and polysaccharides, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
